page.overview:
Who is Darth Kozyr?

Darth Kozyr was an individual affiliated with the Sith The Twi'lek Jedi Master Skia Ro famously defeated them in the Battle of Jabo at some point by a fact that was known to Ro's apprentice Christina Starspeeder.

Darth Kozyr was mentioned in Revenge of the Sis, the 2019 seventh entry in the Star Wars: Jedi Academy non-canon young-reader book series. The book was written by Jarrett J. Krosoczka and Amy Ignatow.
